userInstruction: Deep-read both main papers and SI, then review body structure, Chinese expression, scientific precision, transferable insights and actual mobile typography before release. Today cover screenshot only; retrospective concept cover last; chemical structures must be literal source cutouts.
scopeActuallyRead: Main scientific narratives and their SI substrate definitions, condition development, relevant experimental procedures, crossover and isotope controls, kinetic/ee time courses, product resubjection, NMR titrations, KIE discussion, DFT methods/results and original figure panels. Full text extraction is not claimed as a manual inspection of every spectrum or every Cartesian coordinate.

findings.correction: Migration S1 28%, nonmigratory reduction 13 30%, recovered unsaturated amine 2n 30%. Combined 88% is not migration yield. Secondary/tertiary refers to the carbon attached to N, not amine N substitution.
All four isotope controls are now represented, including ethylene glycol-d6. Carbon deuteration from PhSiD3 supports silane as H source but does not observe every Fe-H elementary step.

Internal alkene products 13-18 have reported r.r. >20:1 despite some low yields. SI S9 duplicates main Table1 and was removed; S8 is retained as another-substrate independent control, not merged numerically with Table1.

findings.source: Main Fig3A; SI p44 S3 and p47 S4 discussion
findings.correction: Alpha/gamma primarily differ in product double-bond position. Gamma-to-alpha isomerization and changing product ee mean endpoint ratios and e.r. are not direct measures of initial cyclization selectivity.

Experimental KIE3.45 is separated from calculated isotope combinations7.09/1.03/7.33. Catalyst-site deuteration and H/D exchange constrain interpretation; PFTB-OD alone does not prove direct additive proton delivery in the rate-determining step.
IRC is highly asynchronous. The 1.4 kcal/mol enantiomeric Gibbs barrier difference is not conflated with gas-phase electronic distortion+0.143/interactions-1.78/total-1.64 kcal/mol.

sourceDiscrepanciesNotSilentlyResolved: Today main model states4eq PhSiH3; SI4.1 p62 describes4eq then another4eq, with volume/mmol labels requiring author confirmation. Body does not invent a unified procedure.
Today SI4.2 uses different glycol amounts and substrate-specific procedure. Main model conditions are not generalized to the full amino-acid scope.
Retro SI p193 methods says SMD(toluene), results prose says SMD(CHCl3), and energy-figure prose referencesS22 while the corresponding diagram isS23. No silent choice of a corrected solvent label.
